summary: Read your Wallabag articles anywhere. Needs an account.
page_description: Bring saved Wallabag articles to your Kobo, then archive or favorite them as you read.
release_notes: Articles to keep now stays as you set it. Articles show their page count and fill each page, and a sync without Wi-Fi offers a Join Wi-Fi button.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Create an API client on your Wallabag server (on wallabag.it: Settings, API clients).

Sign Read Later in from your computer. It asks for the server, the API client and your password, checks them with Wallabag, and sends the sign-in to the reader. Open Read Later, or tap Check again if it is already open.
